item.title: How BAND-MAID Poured Their Determination into ‘Energetic’ Before Their ‘OKYU-JI’ Hiatus
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's podcast, where we're talking about the latest from Japanese rock band, BAND-MAID. They recently released their new single, "ENERGETIC", and we're diving into the story behind it.
[Music transitions to a softer tone]
Host: BAND-MAID just finished their European leg of their world tour, performing in five cities, including a stop at the Download Festival in the UK. We caught up with the band to talk about their experiences. Guitarist KANAMI shared her thoughts on the tour, saying, "This was our first time in Europe in seven years, so I was nervous and a bit worried. But there were no problems at all. You could tell that everyone had been listening to our music and waiting for us."
[Short music clip from BAND-MAID plays]
Host: The band was relieved to see that their fanbase had grown, with drummer AKANE noting that over half the audience at each show were new fans. But what's also notable is that this tour took place after the band announced they'd be taking a break from their live shows, or "OKYU-JI", in 2027.
[Music transitions to a more introspective tone]
Host: According to guitarist and vocalist MIKU KOBATO, their new single, "Days", was written with the intention of resonating with the sadness their fans will feel during their hiatus. Vocalist SAIKI shared that the song's raw lyrics are a promise to their fans, while "ENERGETIC" was written with a brighter future in mind. As KANAMI said, "This year, we're going to make them get out there and dance!"
[Outro music plays]
Host: It's clear that BAND-MAID is dedicated to creating meaningful music and connecting with their fans. We can't wait to see what's next for this talented band. Thanks for tuning in to this week's podcast!
